theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N E : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → InClassO n U N ξN → MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ N ∩ U → IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → ∀ x ∈ T.support, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∃ y ∈ T.support ∩ ball x ρ, HasMassDensity T y 1
